openings.claim: Making the existing completed sample a required reference during each envelope's final filling may prevent quantity omissions. This evaluates a proposed probe; the sample mechanism alone is unproven against the complete workshop outcome.
openings.delta: For the assigned pattern, expose the envelope contents beside its existing sample, compare each specified item, quantity and dimension, correct discrepancies, then close the envelope. The sample's existing contents-reference function becomes a per-kit operation instead of an occasionally consulted display.
openings.prediction: If infrequent reference use causes omissions, per-kit comparison should intercept missing items, particularly shared materials. To satisfy the task, all 60 assignment-matching kits must finish, including checks, within 90 minutes with at most one distribution correction; fewer omissions alone would not establish success.
openings.rival_prediction: The nearest alternative is that volunteers already know the contents and omissions occur during transfer or escape visual comparison. Required sample use would then add time without materially reducing omissions. O4's different small-batch arrangement or unknown pattern mixture could explain its stipulated zero omissions independently of samples.
openings.defeat: Frequent documented sample comparison followed by multiple omitted items defeats the proposed omission mechanism; exceeding 90 minutes or more than one distribution correction defeats qualification under the full task, even if omissions decrease.
openings.probe: In one prospective run, exactly two volunteers attempt the actual 60 assigned kits within 90 minutes on the existing table, using only existing envelopes, materials, samples, pencils and tally sheets. Record sample comparisons, intercepted errors, total time, shortages and distribution corrections. Stop at the time limit and count unfinished kits as failure. No benefit is yet observed.
assumptions: Existing samples permit accurate comparison of specified quantities and dimensions within the available table area.
Comparison overhead fits the remaining time margin; O1's stipulated assembly plus checking already exceeds 90 minutes.
Supply availability and assigned-pattern recognition remain unresolved: sample comparison does not itself resolve O5's shortage or O7's exchanges.
